svg.title: Skill 07 - Reset: soft, mixed, hard
svg.desc: Animation: the branch pointer moves back from commit C to B three times; a table shows that --soft keeps changes staged, --mixed keeps them unstaged, and --hard discards them.

g.text: --soft moves the branch back and keeps the changes staged.
--mixed (the default) moves it back and keeps changes unstaged.
--hard moves it back and throws the changes away. Careful!
Lost a commit with --hard? git reflog can still bring it back.
